audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Mordekaiser for Level 1, Level 3, first item and 2+ items while the whys on those rows say Aurora pokes for free at 1, that 3 is contested, and that she reclaims the duel late.
audit.why: The chart contradicted its own why column on five of seven rows; the packet levelChart (Aurora / Mordekaiser / Skill / Aurora / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Aurora) matches the whys exactly.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet read in matched full+content pairs, ratings rescaled, and phases[2]/[3]/[6] why-text rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked cooldown was called "Twofold Hex (Blink)". Twofold Hex is her Q, a 900-range curse missile; the leap is Across the Veil (W). No timer appeared anywhere.
audit.why: The packet flags that the page never names a real Aurora ability, and the one name it used was attached to the wrong slot.
audit.corrected: Every tracked-cooldown surface now names Across the Veil at 22s rank 1 with its 700-range leap, and Twofold Hex as the 900-range poke whose recast carries the damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five places said Across the Veil makes her untargetable and blanks your R. Riot’s W text says she becomes invisible and gains Move Speed — it never says untargetable.
audit.why: Untargetability would blank a targeted 650-range Realm of Death; invisibility does not, so the advice to fear the W mid-R rested on a mechanic the data does not support.
audit.corrected: whys[6], spikes[3], mid, late, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1] now say she leaps and vanishes and tell you to fight while the 22s is spent, with no untargetability claim.

edits.before: "This is where Aurora takes over. Full-AP she kites you with E blinks, goes untargetable through W to blank your R, and roots-then-bursts from a range your slow Q and single gap-close can't close. Win on your spikes — punish 6 and your first item hard — and look to R her in a side skirmish where she has no escape angle, because a straight-up late teamfight favors her kiting every time."

edits.before: "At 6 your R is the equalizer — banish her 1v1 before she banks W exile, because in the shadow realm she can't blink to a teammate and your Darkness Rise aura plus stolen stats grind her out. Watch the W: if she phases untargetable mid-R she dodges your aura and burst, so bait it or time R for when it's down. Through Levels 4-5 her Q poke starts pulling ahead, so only commit when your E can connect — otherwise you bleed for free into her scaling."
edits.after: "At 6 your R is the equalizer — banish her 1v1 while Across the Veil is spent, because in the shadow realm she cannot leap to a teammate and your Darkness Rise aura plus stolen stats grind her out. Watch that 22s leap: if she still has it she vanishes out of your aura, so bait it or time R for when it is down. Through Levels 4-5 her Q poke pulls ahead at 900 range, so only commit when your E can connect — otherwise you bleed for free into her scaling."

notes: "Across the Veil makes her untargetable" could not be confirmed or denied from the kit — Riot’s text says invisible only, and untargetability is exactly the class of fact the brief says is absent on purpose. I removed the claim rather than assert either way; if she IS untargetable during the spirit-realm window it is the most important line on this page and should be restored deliberately. Also not asserted: Mordekaiser Q’s derived grounding flag, so the missingInteractions headline that Q shuts off Across the Veil and Between Worlds was not written — the same call the aurora-side audit made. The needs-antiheal interaction IS supported (Spirit Abjuration’s spirits heal her); every slot that could carry it was already spending its length on the naming fix, so Grievous Wounds is worth adding to report[8] on a later pass.
